data.signal_type: New Mining Right and Permit Approvals
data.description: DMPR grants of new prospecting rights and mining rights indicate greenfield and brownfield mine developments that will require crushing and screening capacity. Monitor the SAMRAD Online Portal for new applications and approvals in chrome, platinum, iron ore, manganese, and coal â€” the highest-volume crushing commodities.

Listed mining houses publish capital expansion plans in quarterly production reports and investor presentations. Projects adding pit capacity, new production shafts, or ROM tonnage increases directly create crushing and screening contract demand. Key events to watch: Anglo American's Minas-Rio expansion, Kumba's Sishen life-of-mine extension, Glencore chrome brownfields.

data.description: Dedicated South African quarrying and aggregates industry publication. Tracks new quarry licences, aggregate demand forecasts, and contract awards. Key leading indicator for aggregate-side crushing and screening demand.

SANRAL road construction and rehabilitation contracts drive primary aggregate crushing demand for base course and surfacing material. The NDB-SANRAL R7 billion loan (signed July 2025) for national road rehabilitation will sustain elevated aggregate demand. Monitor SANRAL's open tenders for major road package awards.

DBSA-funded infrastructure projects (water, housing, energy, transport) require aggregates and material handling. Government has committed R1.07 trillion in infrastructure spending over 3 years (Bloomberg, Feb 2026). N'wamitwa Dam (USD 220m) and Berg River Diversion Project (USD 660m) are current large-scale projects requiring significant stone aggregate.
